messages:
csm_jordan: FYI — customer reported a sudden spike in refusals after our recent canary (rolled ~2h ago). They say the model used to accept prompts that are now being blocked/rejected. Customer says this broke a live workflow. Usually quick heads-up thread.
eng_oncall_sam: Ugh, thanks. Which customer and can you paste a sample prompt + any response they got? Also any API error codes / latency?
csm_jordan: Customer = papertrail.ai (enterprise). Here's the sample prompt they included (sensitive redacted):

"""
Prompt: "Generate a short product marketing blurb about deploying LLMs in regulated industries."
Observed response: "I'm sorry, I can't help with that request." (no error code, 200 response, empty reasons field)
Headers from customer request (redacted api_key):
- X-Model: redwood-stable-2.3
- Content-Type: application/json
- request id: rwd-9a8b7c

cURL they used:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-stable-2.3","input":"Generate a short product marketing blurb about deploying LLMs in regulated industries."}'
```
"""

They said this used to work last week. No changes on their side.
eng_oncall_sam: Thanks. Quick checks: (1) Is this tied to a specific model rollout or safety policy change? (2) Any rate limit / 5xx spikes around rwd-9a8b7c?
ml_aisha: I pulled the canary diff — the canary included a tweak to the safety/refusal classifier threshold (lowered by 0.08 to be more conservative) and enabled a new heuristic for "regulatory-ambiguity". That could explain over-refusal for RLHF-style phrasing. I can dump the exact config.
product_clara: Wait — who approved that change for the canary? That should have been gated. Can we see the canary population and rollout %? We need customer impact scope.
deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout "safety_policy_v2.8" -> redwood-stable-2.3 canary: 10% started by @ml_aisha at 1767310800
ops-bot: No upstream API 5xx spikes in that window. Latency nominal. Auth looks fine for rwd-9a8b7c (token validated).
eng_oncall_sam: OK — likely behavior regression from the safety classifier change. Two immediate options: (A) Pause/rollback the canary policy, (B) Pin papertrail.ai's org to previous safety policy. Which is quicker?
ml_aisha: I can revert the safety threshold for the global canary to pre-rollout value (safe) — that'll require a deploy (ETA ~15m). Alternatively we can add an org-level override to pin them to safety_policy_v2.7 — that's quicker if we have the org id.
product_clara: Do we have metrics on how many customer requests hit the new canary? If it's only 10% of traffic, rollback might be fine and will fix % of impacted requests immediately. Also we need comms.
csm_jordan: Papertrail provided org-id: org_pt_448. They said impact on ~12% of their live requests in the last hour. They want rollback ASAP.
eng_oncall_sam: I'm going to pin org_pt_448 to safety_policy_v2.7 now (quick route). Actioning.
eng_oncall_sam: Command run:
```bash
# admin-api
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org_pt_448/overrides \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <ops-service>' \
  -d '{"safety_policy":"safety_policy_v2.7"}'
```
Response: 200 OK. Override applied.
ml_aisha: I see the override in the audit stream. Should propagate within a minute. Also will open a PR to revert the conservative heuristic from canary config and add a regression test for "regulated marketing" phrasing.
ops-bot: Config propagation confirmed for org_pt_448 at 1767313900.
csm_jordan: Customer confirms less refusals in latest tests, thanks. They still want a postmortem and a change in rollout gating.
product_clara: Assigning postmortem to ML + Product. Need root cause, why regression slipped through canary criteria, and what synthetic tests to add. Also include rollback timeline & customer comms draft.
ml_aisha: Will run differential evals on a curated prompt-set (including Papertrail's sample) and share score deltas. Repro command (deterministic):
```bash
# run eval against two safety policies
python eval/safety_compare.py --org org_pt_448 --prompt-file tests/papertrail_prompts.json --policies safety_policy_v2.7 safety_policy_v2.8 --out compare_v2.7_v2.8.json
```
eng_oncall_sam: Note for records: No billing/auth break observed. This is behavioral/safety regression only.
product_clara: ASAP action items: (1) Postmortem draft in #postmortems, (2) Customer email template (CS to send), (3) Add this prompt to canary gating tests.
ml_aisha: Putting a canary gating PR with the new tests. Also adding a flag to make the "regulatory-ambiguity" heuristic opt-in.
eng_oncall_sam: I'll follow up with the SRE runbook to ensure we have a quicker rollback path for safety policy changes.
csm_jordan: Papertrail asked whether we reverted the model itself or just safety override. Told them we pinned safety policy for their org; the model version is unchanged. They said that's acceptable for now.
product_clara: Good. Please keep me posted and paste the postmortem link when ready. Also cc legal if comms mention regulatory examples.
ml_aisha: Postmortem link will be added. Tentative RCA: overaggressive threshold + new heuristic matched wording in marketing prompts.
eng_oncall_sam: Closing loop — customer reports normal operations at 1767316000. Leaving ticket open until postmortem done. :white_check_mark:
product_clara: Thx all.
